title: Excellent Quality
text: Excellent Quality. I have several tiered trays in my house. I love decorating with them. I was drawn to this one because of the interesting octagon shape. There are 3 tiers. They have a slight edge which keeps things from falling off. It was easy to put together. The quality is excellent!
